meaning.en: Archetype of functional awareness that helps learners recognize what each word is doing in a sentence, especially auxiliary and modal verbs.
meaning.es: Arquetipo de conciencia funcional que ayuda al alumno a reconocer qué función cumple cada palabra en una oración, especialmente los verbos auxiliares y modales.
meaning.pt: Arquétipo de consciência funcional que ajuda o aluno a reconhecer o que cada palavra está fazendo na sentença, especialmente os verbos auxiliares e modais.

firstCase.diagnosis: CAN already performs the modal auxiliary function; DO is not required in this interrogative structure.
